delete.summary: Clears a team's avatar and queues unreferenced File cleanup.

post.summary: Replaces a team's avatar with an immutable File reference.

get.summary: Gets the signed-in member's latest team ban case.
get.description: Returns the source category and private appeal state without exposing staff evidence.

post.summary: Submits one private appeal for the current team ban.
post.description: Only the captain may submit, and each immutable ban event accepts at most one appeal.

post.summary: Consume a PatchUpload and create a Fix attempt.
post.description: PatchUpload consumption and durable evaluation dispatch are atomic.

post.summary: Submit one Flag or an ordered AWD Flag collection.
post.description: Creates independent immutable attempts. The accepted response is not an evaluation result.
Validates and stores one gzip-compressed tar archive without creating a submission.

get.description: Only Running instances expose expanded public URLs.
During hardening only the caller's team is returned; afterwards every eligible team is retained even when it has no running URLs.
Streams the administrator-configured public raster logo.
Exposes the configured name, description, and revisioned logo URL.
Returns the current user's immutable notification event stream.

get.summary: Read the current identity's incremental notification feed.
get.description: The first request returns an empty safe checkpoint. Later requests return events in ascending creation order.
Returns the immutable linear notification chain in chronological order.
Returns only the archive bound to the internal JWT submission claim.

post.summary: Updates the status reported by an AWD checker.
post.description: Each accepted update replaces the runtime's previous checker status. Runtime identity and generation come from the internal JWT.

post.summary: Records a claim-bound AWDP fix result.
post.description: SubmissionId and ProcessingVersion come exclusively from the internal JWT.

get.summary: Get the cached leaderboard or queue an asynchronous refresh.

post.summary: Explicitly reads one protected submitted Flag.
post.description: Administrator, owner, manager, and judge only. Every successful access appends an immutable audit event.

get.summary: Exports a bounded competition event range as JSON Lines.
get.description: Administrator, competition owner, and manager only; at most 31 days and 50,000 events.

get.summary: Lists one competition's immutable event feed.
get.description: Applies participant, team, and staff visibility before returning a signed keyset page.

get.summary: Downloads the team's fixed RandomOnePerTeam attachment.
get.description: The first request atomically selects a candidate and persists the selection as a team ChallengeFlag fact.
RandomOnePerTeam challenges deliberately return 404 from this route.

get.summary: Lists published challenges for a competition.

post.description: The first paid unlock creates a HintUnlock fact from an authoritative database projection.

post.summary: Adds a private message to a competition question.
post.description: Asker follow-ups return Replied or Resolved questions to Pending; handler replies move Pending questions to Replied. Closed questions are terminal.

put.description: Every accepted transition creates an immutable audit entry. The asker may resolve a replied question; handlers may resolve or irreversibly close it.

post.description: Challenge questions target one published CompetitionChallenge; platform questions target competition management. Attachments are not accepted and an optional Submission is referenced without copying its protected content.

get.summary: Lists competition questions visible to the current user.
get.description: The asker receives their own threads; observers receive read-only projections and handlers receive their authorized queue.
Private content is projected only to the asker, read-only observers, competition handlers, and the linked challenge authors.

put.description: Rehashes the password and invalidates all existing tokens.

post.description: Consumes a single-use reset token, changes the password, and invalidates all sessions.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account profile.

get.summary: Returns a user's current public avatar.

post.description: Increments TokenVersion and clears the current refresh cookie.
Creates a local account with an Identity V3 password hash.
Always accepts a valid email-shaped request without revealing account existence.
Queues a new single-use email verification message.

put.summary: Updates the current user's profile and email visibility.

post.summary: Replaces the current user's cropped avatar.

post.description: Consumes a single-use email verification token.

post.summary: Accepts a private team ban appeal.
post.description: Corrects the ban, restores historical scoring eligibility, and publishes a generic correction.
Approves team registration while the competition still permits review changes.
Excludes the team from private access and scoring and schedules runtime cleanup.

post.summary: Corrects the current team ban without requiring an appeal.
post.description: Available after competition finish; it restores the historical projection and publishes only a generic correction.

get.summary: Lists all competition teams for management.
get.description: Returns registration and moderation state to authorized competition observers.
Observers and judges may read; only administrators, owners, and managers may resolve.

post.description: Rejects team registration while the competition still permits review changes.
Restores the team's historical scoring eligibility and normal runtime lifecycle.

post.summary: Upholds a team ban appeal privately.
post.description: Records a terminal private decision without publishing a correction.

post.summary: Queues a signed manual score adjustment.
post.description: The delta is persisted as the canonical signed Int32 SubmittedFlag on a ManualAdjust submission.

get.description: Returns protected submission content, current evaluation, and management diagnostics.
Returns keyset-paged protected submission facts to authorized competition observers.

post.description: Creates cutoff-bounded durable work for eligible ManualBatch or first-failure submissions.

post.summary: Queues one submission for exact rejudge.
post.description: Reuses the original submission and archive without creating or consuming a new attempt.
Schedules durable filtered rejudging without creating a batch business entity.
Uses the normal runtime state machine and does not bypass TTL or mode policy.
Queues Runner-owned identity cleanup for a runtime stuck in Provisioning or Stopping for at least five minutes.

get.description: Includes provider receipt and internal failure diagnostics hidden from players.
Returns keyset-paged runtime state and placement metadata to authorized observers.

post.summary: Queues a KoH shared runtime replacement.
post.description: Replaces the shared hill through the normal generation-fenced runtime state machine.

post.summary: Queues an atomic team runtime replacement.
post.description: Uses the same generation and replacement invariants as the player runtime API.

post.summary: Queues a KoH shared runtime start.
post.description: Starts the shared hill without fabricating a team owner.
Uses the normal mode, capacity, and runtime ownership policy for the selected team.

post.summary: Queues a KoH shared runtime stop.
post.description: Stops the shared hill through the durable runtime cleanup state machine.
Stops the selected team's runtime through durable provider cleanup.
Queues durable provider cleanup for the selected instance and rejects stale processing versions.
Creates a User Notification Relay Bot or Organizer GitOps Bot that cannot use password login or refresh tokens.

delete.summary: Deletes or irreversibly anonymizes a platform user.
delete.description: Physical deletion is allowed only without business references. Anonymization preserves all historical records and never cascades them.

get.description: Returns platform identity and token-version metadata to administrators only.

get.summary: Exports bounded platform runtime logs as JSON Lines.
get.description: Exports at most 50,000 redacted API, Worker, and Runner entries within the 14-day retention window.
Returns delivery metadata without message bodies, secrets, or exception text.

get.summary: Gets email verification and SMTP configuration.
get.description: Returns non-secret platform settings and whether an SMTP password is configured.

put.description: Applies non-secret verification and SMTP settings with a revision fence.

get.description: Returns public branding fields with their optimistic revision.

put.description: Applies public branding text with an optimistic revision fence.

get.summary: Returns the running platform version and contributors.
get.description: Reports build metadata and the repository contributor identity snapshot.

post.summary: Invalidates every access and refresh token for a user.
post.description: Atomically increments the user's global token version.

post.summary: Issues a bounded-lifetime Access JWT for a Bot.
post.description: Uses the ordinary Access scheme and is revoked by the Bot's TokenVersion.

get.description: Message bodies and exception messages are deliberately omitted.
Projects immutable competition events and user-account lifecycle audits without duplicating business history.
Returns bounded API, Worker, and Runner history. Warning is the default minimum level.
Returns platform role and token-version metadata to administrators only.

get.summary: Previews the impact of deleting a platform user.
get.description: Reports historical references and whether physical deletion or irreversible anonymization is currently allowed.

put.description: Replaces the encrypted SMTP password without returning it.

post.summary: Queues a Wolverine dead letter for durable replay.
post.description: Creates a new delivery attempt while preserving the original failed record.
Sends a test message to the current administrator.

put.summary: Updates a platform role and invalidates existing tokens.
put.description: Atomically changes the bounded user role and increments the token version unless active owner or manager assignments block a downgrade.

post.description: Stores a validated raster logo and advances the platform configuration revision.
Administrator, competition owner, and manager only. Plaintext Flags are excluded unless a human Administrator explicitly supplies a reason.

get.description: Administrator, competition owner, and manager only. Administrators can inspect every recent job; other callers see only their own jobs.

post.summary: Queues a complete platform audit export.
post.description: Exports projections of immutable competition events and user lifecycle audits as NDJSON.

get.summary: Lists recent platform audit export jobs.
get.description: Administrator only. Returns the latest durable platform audit export jobs and their retention state.

get.summary: Downloads an available data export artifact.
get.description: Revalidates current scope access before streaming an available, unexpired export artifact.

delete.description: Removes the poster reference and queues cleanup when the immutable File is no longer referenced.

post.description: Stores a validated image as an immutable File and atomically replaces the competition poster reference.
Management announcements default to collaborators; participant visibility must be explicit.
Creates a draft competition owned by the current organizer or administrator.

get.summary: Lists competitions visible to the current administrator.
get.description: Resource permissions, not the /admin path alone, determine visibility.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an inactive competition owned or managed by the caller.

get.description: Returns draft or public competition metadata when the caller has resource access.

put.description: Updates mutable competition metadata using the current lifecycle state as the concurrency fence.

post.description: Transitions an active competition to Finished and schedules runtime cleanup.

post.summary: Synchronously generates missing CTF PerTeam and KoH flags.
post.description: The response contains only stable failure metadata and never exposes flags or counts.

get.description: Returns the versioned configuration JSON visible to competition administrators.

put.description: Validates and replaces versioned configuration JSON using optimistic concurrency.

get.summary: Gets the scheduled and effective leaderboard visibility policy.
get.description: Returns the revision-fenced Normal, Frozen, or Blackout configuration for a competition.

put.summary: Schedules or immediately applies leaderboard visibility.
put.description: Uses a dedicated revision fence and persists the exact Frozen cutoff snapshot when the restriction takes effect.

get.summary: Gets the complete competition permission snapshot.
get.description: Returns owner, manager, judge, and observer assignments only to the competition owner or a platform administrator.

put.description: Assigns mutually exclusive manager, judge, and observer user arrays.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes an empty soft-deleted competition.
delete.description: Restrict foreign keys prevent deleting a competition that owns durable facts.

get.description: Returns a resource-scoped, minimal user projection only to the competition owner or a platform administrator.

post.description: Moves a Draft or Published competition to Visible.
Freezes effective running time and mode scheduling until the competition resumes.
Moves a competition through the documented publication lifecycle state machine.
Restores a competition when the caller is its owner or a platform administrator.
Restarts effective running time and durable mode scheduling.
Transitions the competition to Running and queues runtime provisioning.
Assigns a new eligible owner and moves the previous owner into the manager set.

get.description: Returns every current stable, deduplicated start error without changing state.

post.summary: Confirms one incident and bans its source team.
post.description: Administrator, owner, manager, and judge only. The public competition notification contains no Flag or private evidence.

post.summary: Corrects a confirmed incident and unbans its source team.
post.description: Administrator, owner, and manager only. A safe correction notice is delivered to the whole competition.

post.summary: Dismisses one pending cheat incident with an audit reason.
post.description: Administrator, owner, manager, and judge only. Dismissal is silent and does not ban a team.

get.summary: Reads one protected cross-team Flag incident.
get.description: Administrator, owner, manager, and judge only. The full Flag response is never cached and every successful read is audited.
Observer and above may list redacted evidence. Only current scoring facts and immutable adjudication events are used.

post.summary: Links a global challenge template to a competition.
post.description: Creates a CompetitionChallenge without copying or mutating the global template.

get.description: Includes unpublished challenge instances for authorized competition observers.

post.description: Creates a protected flag answer scoped to one CompetitionChallenge.

get.description: Returns protected flag records for one CompetitionChallenge to authorized observers.

post.description: Creates hint content, cost, and optional publication timing for one challenge instance.

get.description: Returns every hint and its publication metadata for one challenge instance.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the competition link at the expected aggregate revision without changing the global challenge template.

get.description: Returns management details for published or unpublished competition challenges.

put.description: Updates scoring, ordering, and publication state using optimistic concurrency.

delete.description: Soft-deletes one protected flag from the CompetitionChallenge scope.

get.description: Returns protected flag material to authorized competition observers.

put.description: Replaces protected flag material and validity metadata within one CompetitionChallenge.

delete.description: Soft-deletes one hint owned by the CompetitionChallenge.

get.description: Returns full hint content and publication metadata to authorized observers.

put.description: Updates hint content, cost, and publication timing for one challenge instance.

get.summary: Gets a competition challenge's game-mode configuration.
get.description: Returns the versioned challenge configuration JSON visible to competition administrators.

put.summary: Updates a competition challenge's game-mode configuration.
put.description: Validates and replaces versioned challenge configuration JSON using optimistic concurrency.

post.description: Restores the competition link at the expected aggregate revision; the global template is not modified.
Restores a soft-deleted flag owned by the selected competition challenge.

post.summary: Restores a deleted competition challenge hint.
post.description: Restores a soft-deleted hint owned by the selected competition challenge.
Adds protected static flag material to a global challenge template.

get.description: Returns protected static flag records to authorized template managers.

post.description: Creates a reusable question-bank template independent of any competition.

get.description: Returns owned, managed, shared, or platform-administrator-visible templates.

delete.description: Soft-deletes attachment metadata and schedules owned object cleanup.
Soft-deletes protected static flag material from a global template.

get.description: Returns protected static flag material to an authorized template manager.

put.description: Replaces protected flag material and validity metadata within the template scope.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an unreferenced reusable challenge template.

get.description: Returns reusable template metadata according to challenge-bank visibility rules.

put.description: Updates the reusable template and never changes competition-owned ordering or scoring.

get.description: Returns protected attachment metadata to authorized template managers.

post.description: The server generates the object key and persists length and SHA-256 metadata.
Restores attachment metadata while preserving its stored object and stable ID.
Restores a soft-deleted template-scoped static flag by stable ID.

post.summary: Restores a soft-deleted global challenge template.
post.description: Restores a reusable template for its owner, a manager, or a platform administrator.
Assigns an eligible new owner while preserving the previous owner as a manager.

put.summary: Replaces the challenge template manager set.
put.description: Assigns the complete manager set while preserving the sole owner source of truth.
